title: Bronze Pendant
content:
# Bronze Pendant

Internal ID: TrinketBronzeStamina | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Bronze x5, Bear trophy x1, Ruby x3 | Adrenaline Cost: 50 | Effect: +25% stamina regen | Duration: 1m

# Introduction

Bronze Pendant is a Black Forest-tier trinket, and one of the first available in the game.

## Effects

Once 50 Adrenaline has been gained, the Bronze Pendant will trigger automatically, providing +25% stamina regeneration for 60 seconds.

Categorias: Trinket
